closedBody: Roster moves are locked, players cannot leave, be removed from, or disband teams until the window reopens.

joinWarning.title: You won't be able to leave this team for a while

body.join: The transfer window is closed. You can still join {team}, but once you do you can't leave it.
body.request: The transfer window is closed. If {team} accepts your request, you can't leave the team.
body.invite: The transfer window is closed. You can still accept this invite to {team}, but once you do you can't leave it.
body.create: The transfer window is closed. You can still create {team}, but you can't leave or disband it.

joinWarning.until: You'll be free to leave from {date}, when the window opens.
joinWarning.untilUnknown: You'll be free to leave when the next window opens. No date has been set yet.
